name: Hazael
bio:
Hazael is first named at Horeb, where the LORD instructed Elijah to anoint him king over Syria (1 Kings 19:15) — one of three anointings Elijah was told to carry out, alongside Jehu as king over Israel and Elisha as prophet in his own place, together forming the LORD's instruments of judgment against the house of Ahab and against Baal worship in Israel (1 Kings 19:15-18).

## 📖 Core Story: Smothering Ben-Hadad

When Ben-Hadad, king of Syria, fell sick while Elisha was visiting Damascus, he sent Hazael with a huge gift to ask through Elisha whether he would recover. Elisha told Hazael plainly that Ben-Hadad would certainly die, then wept, explaining he knew the evil Hazael himself would do to Israel — burning strongholds, killing young men, and slaughtering children and pregnant women. Hazael protested he was no one capable of such things, but Elisha told him the LORD had shown that he would become king over Syria. Hazael lied to Ben-Hadad about Elisha's prophecy, then the next day smothered him to death with a wet cloth and took the throne for himself (2 Kings 8:7-15). He later fought Jehoram (Joram) king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah at Ramoth Gilead, wounding Jehoram (2 Kings 8:28-29).
